description: This file defines a PHP class 'CasesController' which extends 'SugarController'. It includes methods related to fetching knowledge base articles and article details for a customer relationship management system, specifically handling actions for retrieving knowledge base articles and their details, and also includes a utility method for string validation.

classes.name: CasesController
classes.description: Controller class for handling case-related actions, extending the core SugarController to include specific methods for knowledge base article retrieval and display.

methods.name: action_get_kb_articles
methods.description: Fetches a list of knowledge base articles matching a search term, constructs and outputs an HTML table with results.

methods.name: action_get_kb_article
methods.description: Retrieves and displays detailed information about a specific knowledge base article.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Utility function to check whether a provided string is null or consists only of whitespace.
